name: diff-ask
description: Live workspace diff panel with a '+' on every diff line: click it, write a question, and it reaches the conversation anchored to the exact file and line.

description_i18n.en: Live workspace diff panel with a '+' on every diff line: click it, write a question, and it reaches the conversation anchored to the exact file and line.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 实时工作区差异面板：每行差异都有“+”，点击后写下问题，问题会以精确的文件与行号发进对话。
